evidence.limitation: Ensemble sheet review and three original anchors; not full-resolution individual inspection of every work or a visitor study

title: The Body Makes a Gesture
question: Where does movement begin in a still drawing?
introduction: Compare the directions of a body, its limbs and the lines around it. Raised arms, bent heads, broad clothing-like forms and quieter upright stances offer different ways to read a pose. Follow changes between sparse contours and layered bodies. A movement suggested by the outline may differ from the direction of the surrounding marks.
closing: Choose a pose and follow one line beyond its body. Does that line reinforce the stance, or lead your eye in another direction?

chapters.title: Bodies That Expand Outward
chapters.introduction: Five figures whose limbs, marks, or silhouettes push toward the edges of the frame, testing how far a body can extend before its outline loses coherence.

stops.whyHere: Raised arm, kicked leg, and sweeping white arcs all drive outward from a dense crossed-line core, making expansion the image's central visible fact.
stops.title: nnxyz nnotb #54

stops.whyHere: Arms wide, one leg forward, mouth open — the figure lunges in multiple directions at once, but semi-transparent layered loops let the olive ground show through the body.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: Both figures throw limbs outward across their grounds, but where nnxyz nnotb #54 is built on dense colored strokes, nnxyz nnotb #32 uses transparent loops that dissolve the body's edges.
stops.title: nnxyz nnotb #32

stops.whyHere: Splayed limbs radiate in all directions; dense overlapping loops build the body and the squared, open-toothed face amplifies the sense of outward force to its loudest point in the chapter.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nnotb #32's transparency gives way to dense tangled loops, and the open mouth shifts from a lunge into something closer to a shout.
stops.title: nnxyz nnotb #47

stops.whyHere: One arm arcs wide, the other drops low, pulling the figure into an asymmetric stretch readable as mid-fall or mid-reach rather than display.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: The all-directions explosion of nnxyz nnotb #47 narrows here to a single diagonal pull between two unequal arms, making the imbalance more precise and quieter.
stops.title: nnxyz nnotb #18

stops.whyHere: A single large arching white outline curves over a dense cluster of upright colored lines — no figure, but the same outward-then-inward pull of the chapter's poses rendered as pure line and mark.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nnotb #18's asymmetric figure gives way to a composition without a readable body: the arching curve and crowded verticals carry the chapter's tension between expansion and compression in abstract form.
stops.title: nnxyz nnotb #44

chapters.title: Figures That Hold Their Ground
chapters.introduction: Six figures that stand squarely or crouch forward, occupying their space with a directness that sits between ceremony and confrontation, facing the viewer without retreating.

stops.whyHere: Arms out, feet planted in three flat rectangular shapes, the figure braces against the frame — rigid, wired, and facing the viewer without flinching.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: After nnxyz nnotb #44's abstract curve, a figure snaps into view with bilateral symmetry: both arms level, both feet grounded, the body locked into a confrontational square.
stops.title: nnxyz nnotb #29

stops.whyHere: Wide hat, spread arms, ribcage visible through bright torso stripes — the figure plants itself on a flat teal ground, grin exposed, with no depth to retreat into.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nnotb #29's rigid outline gives way to warm color and a grinning face, but the spread-arm, feet-planted stance is identical, shifting tone without changing posture.
stops.title: nnxyz nnotb #30

stops.whyHere: Oversized scribbled head, one arm raised with a pointing finger, one arm extended right, legs crossed below — a wide reach above a narrow, unstable base.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nnotb #30's grin and bright hat are replaced by a dense multi-color scribbled head on dark teal; the arms stay wide but the crossed legs introduce instability beneath.
stops.title: nnxyz nnotb #46

stops.whyHere: A flat cyan profile figure stands on deep red, both arms extended forward at different heights, fingers spread — the profile stance and uneven reach hold the ground while keeping the gesture open-ended.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nnotb #46's frontal pose and scribbled density give way to a clean flat profile: two colors only, the figure simplified to silhouette, the gesture shifted from display to reach.
stops.title: nnxyz nnotb #264

stops.whyHere: Crouching, splayed, claws visible at the corners — the figure pushes toward the viewer from a void, its red X eyes and bared teeth making the confrontation explicit.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nnotb #264's clean flat profile gives way to dense scribbled mass on black; the profile stance becomes a frontal crouch, and the open gesture becomes a push toward the viewer.
stops.title: nnxyz nnotb #33

stops.whyHere: Upright with pointed ears and flower-ring eyes, the figure holds its ground while zigzag bands cut across it like interference, making alertness and disruption coexist in the same form.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nnotb #33's void-black ground opens into a blue-purple wash, and the cancellation marks become flower rings — confrontation softened but not resolved.
stops.title: nnxyz nnotb #242

chapters.title: Bodies in Transit
chapters.introduction: Six figures caught at angles that read as momentum — pitching forward, tilting sideways, or suspended between a step and a stumble, held at an unstable point.

stops.whyHere: The figure pitches forward on comb-toothed feet, one arm raking right, its skeleton visible through a window of clashing color blocks inside the tilted torso.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: From nnxyz nnotb #242's upright alertness, the body tips forward here: the confrontational stance becomes a lean, and the interior becomes literally transparent.
stops.title: nnxyz nnotb #31

stops.whyHere: Steep forward pitch, one foot planted on a hard diagonal ground line, the other leg trailing — dense crossed lines fill the body while red marks locked inside the head stay contained.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nnotb #31's warm amber ground is replaced by a yellow-green field split by a hard black diagonal, sharpening the sense that the figure is about to cross a threshold.
stops.title: nnxyz nnotb #55

stops.whyHere: A hooked limb and absent arm tip a compact figure into a stance readable as a bow, a stumble, or a ceremony — the asymmetry keeps all three readings open.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nnotb #55's full-body lurch compresses here into a single asymmetric detail: one hooked arm versus no arm, a smaller imbalance with a quieter, more ambiguous charge.
stops.title: nnxyz nnotb #258

stops.whyHere: A dark silhouette leans back hard, oversized head swinging wide to the right, forked lines floating free above the solid mass — the lean is away from the viewer rather than toward it.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nnotb #258 tips forward; nnxyz nnotb #263 tips backward, reversing the direction of imbalance while keeping the same high-contrast two-color flatness.
stops.title: nnxyz nnotb #263

stops.whyHere: Steep forward lean, X-marked eyes, long fingers nearly grazing the ground — the figure stays upright while reading as mid-collapse, held by a single vertical axis.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nnotb #263's backward lean reverses into a forward drop; where nnxyz nnotb #263 is a flat silhouette, nnxyz nnotb #121 is a detailed figure whose crossed-out eyes and dangling hands make the tilt feel exhausted.
stops.title: nnxyz nnotb #121

stops.whyHere: Two forms share weight without touching: an isolated limb on the left and a compressed spiked mass above, connected only by trailing lines that pull the eye downward.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nnotb #121's single figure nearly touching the ground gives way to a split composition — the body divided into separate parts, the lean distributed across a gap rather than held in one form.
stops.title: nnxyz nnotb #148

chapters.title: Figures That Turn Inward
chapters.introduction: Six figures whose postures close rather than open: bowed heads, arms that block rather than reach, and bodies compressed within their surrounding pictorial space.

stops.whyHere: One pale arm raised to cover the face entirely, yellow-orange pressing in from every edge — the gesture closes the figure off rather than extending it outward.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: After nnxyz nnotb #148's divided, suspended forms, a single arm performs the opposite of reach: it blocks, turning the body inward against a bright, insistent surround.
stops.title: nnxyz nnotb #137

stops.whyHere: Head bowed, wrists crossed low, gold-olive mass spreading across the shoulders — the figure withdraws while black lines scratch outward around it in all directions.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nnotb #137's blocking arm is replaced by crossed wrists and a bowed head; the gesture of closure becomes more deliberate, and the surrounding marks grow more agitated.
stops.title: nnxyz nnotb #138

stops.whyHere: A hooded figure holds its ground at center, face compressed and eyes low, while diagonal rain-like lines press down from all sides and a bright band sits remote at the top edge.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nnotb #138's warm red-amber glow behind withdrawal becomes a cold dark field here, and the surrounding pressure shifts from scratched lines to falling diagonals.
stops.title: nnxyz nnotb #191

stops.whyHere: The figure bends forward, head down, lines fanning outward from the skull — the bow reads as strain, and the yellow X at the neck is the only color accent in a flat pink field.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nnotb #191's hooded stillness gives way to a bent posture with lines radiating from the head, making the inward turn visible as physical pressure rather than concealment.
stops.title: nnxyz nnotb #126

stops.whyHere: Eyes closed, face sealed, the figure stands still while horizontal fabric bands compress the torso and a wide gold skirt fans outward — stillness held inside a layered structure.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nnotb #126's radiating strain settles here into complete stillness: no lean, no bow, just a closed face and a body wrapped in tight horizontal bands that contain rather than release.
stops.title: nnxyz nnotb #50

stops.whyHere: A sweeping dark skirt-form dominates the lower half while frayed orange-red lines erupt on the right — the figure is split between a contained sweep and an unraveling edge.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nnotb #50's compressed stillness opens at the edges here: the skirt sweeps wide and the right side frays into loose lines, making containment and dispersal visible in the same image.
stops.title: nnxyz nnotb #48

chapters.title: The Body Showing Its Frame
chapters.introduction: Four figures in which the skeleton, outline, or interior construction becomes the subject — bodies that are simultaneously solid and see-through at the same time.

stops.whyHere: Arms spread, ribcage lines in pink and red visible through the torso, a radiating tutu shape at the waist — the figure displays its own construction as part of the pose.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nnotb #48's fraying edge gives way to a figure that makes its internal structure the central visible fact: ribs, joints, and skirt-spokes all equally exposed on a quiet olive ground.
stops.title: nnxyz nnotb #17

stops.whyHere: An inverted skeletal form descends through horizontal bands, bones loosely drawn with gaps between outline and fill — the structure is visible but incomplete, suspended rather than solid.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nnotb #17's upright skeletal figure tips upside-down here, and the quiet olive ground becomes a saturated red field crossed by dark horizontal bands that read as both shadow and barrier.
stops.title: nnxyz nnotb #25

stops.whyHere: A black angular figure leans forward, its interior visible only through two coiled spirals burning inside the wedge-shaped head — structure concentrated into a single charged zone.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nnotb #25's distributed skeletal gaps give way to a solid black silhouette where the only interior detail is locked inside the head, making the contrast between opacity and exposure more stark.
stops.title: nnxyz nnotb #49

stops.whyHere: A large face fills the frame, tan planes marking its structure while yellow zigzags cross it like interference — the face as architecture, hands held at the lower edges without reaching.
stops.transitionFromPrevious: nnxyz nnotb #49's full-body silhouette zooms into a single face here, and the structural lines shift from interior spirals to surface interference, ending the gallery at the body's most legible surface.
stops.title: nnxyz nnotb #295
